resources.string: Disconnect CarPlay first. These are three input uses, not three physical microphones. Record 5 seconds, then play the same audio through media or Siri assistant paths. Before recording, playback uses a quiet one-second tone. Audio stays in memory and is erased on close; device details and levels enter the report. This is not a live Siri session.
Allow microphone access, then tap Record again. If permanently denied, enable Microphone in Android app settings.
Disconnect CarPlay before this local test.
